google_maps_platform_tos.section: Section 3.2.3 (No Scraping, No Caching, No Derivative Database Creation)
google_maps_platform_tos.certification_statement: Zero Point-of-Interest (POI) attributes, geometries, names, or categories are scraped or cached from Google Maps or Google Places API. All persistent POI records derive strictly from the Overture Maps Foundation schema under the CDLA-Permissive-2.0 license. The Google Maps JavaScript API (@vis.gl/react-google-maps) is utilized solely in the browser frontend as an ephemeral, stateless visual canvas rendering markers supplied from the server-side Overture database.
forbidden_operations: Caching Google Places results to SQLite / PostgreSQL
Derivative geospatial database creation from Google Maps

costquest_fcc_fabric_exemption.statutory_basis: Title 47 CFR Part 1 & US Copyright Office Database Compilations
costquest_fcc_fabric_exemption.certification_statement: Zero proprietary CostQuest Broadband Serviceable Location (BSL) Fabric IDs are utilized, referenced, or mocked. Broadband availability indicators are derived exclusively from (a) public Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) Autonomous System Number (ASN) routing tables (AS7018/AS20057 for AT&T Services, Inc.) and (b) public-domain FCC Broadband Data Collection (BDC) H3 Res-8 hexagon summaries.
public_data_sources: Public BGP ASN routing tables (AS7018 / AS20057)
FCC Broadband Data Collection (BDC) H3 Res-8 hexagon layer (public domain)
forbidden_identifiers: CostQuest Broadband Serviceable Location (BSL) Fabric IDs

ccpa_cpra_tcpa_pii_compliance.statutory_basis: California Consumer Privacy Act (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.100 et seq.), TCPA (47 U.S.C. § 227)
ccpa_cpra_tcpa_pii_compliance.certification_statement: No personal contact information is scraped from LinkedIn, corporate team pages, or external social directories. All Decision-Maker Contact records are stored and rendered in pre-masked format with explicit DNC scrub status and carrier line type. Raw PII is never exposed without user initiation of an enterprise licensed CRM audit log event.

cpni_47_usc_222_exemption.statutory_basis: Communications Act of 1934 as amended, 47 U.S.C. § 222 (Customer Proprietary Network Information)
cpni_47_usc_222_exemption.certification_statement: No real carrier telemetry, CDRs, DPI packets, or actual customer traffic metrics are utilized or stored. All consumption metrics are strictly labeled modeled_bandwidth_mbps and modeled_monthly_tb, calculated exclusively via outside-in AI firmographic estimation based on square footage, NAICS industry code, and employee count. Every metric is accompanied by the statutory badge: 'Outside-In AI Firmographic Estimate (Non-CPNI)'.

terminal_sandbox_isolation.certification_statement: Absolute zero-tolerance sandbox isolation policy. BypassSandbox: true is strictly prohibited across all operations.
